name: nuthinking-skills
description: nuthinking's agent skills: Product Map (a repo-native map of what your product does), Product Demo (demo videos of product flows that regenerate when the product changes), Site Edit (edit a website from the website, with an AI agent making the change), Design Catalog (extract the design system a vibe-coded app already has and make every screen follow it), and UI Tweaks (a polished Tweaks panel on top of your running app to fine-tune its craft details live, then hand the changes back to the agent).
